name: Popover
description: Showing a small floating panel of content anchored to a trigger element.
whenToUse: Showing a small floating panel of content anchored to a trigger element.
Displaying tooltip-style information, context menus, or contextual UI that appears on demand without navigating away.
whenNotToUse: The content is a structured list of actions — use Popover menu instead.
The content requires user input or is too complex to fit in a small floating panel — use a dialog instead.
do: Always wrap the trigger and [popover] element in a .pos-popover container — this provides anchor positioning and the caret indicator.
Use <button type="button" popovertarget="id"> as the trigger for correct accessibility.
dont: Use the native [popover] attribute without the .pos-popover wrapper — it will appear unstyled at the top of the viewport.
Place long-form content or forms inside a popover — use a dialog instead.
accessibility: The browser automatically manages focus when the popover opens and closes.
The popover closes on Escape key and on click outside (light dismiss) — no custom JS needed.

props.name: content
props.description: The [popover] panel accepts arbitrary content — not limited to a menu list (see the Popover menu component for that specific case).
